breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal axial force as uniform along the entire bar, even though point loads make the axial force piecewise constant with jumps at the loading points.
breakdown.reason: The agent did not fix this inconsistency. The ground truth corrects the prompt by removing the incorrect instruction to treat the force as uniform. The agent, however, explicitly adopted this flawed instruction, stating, 'The internal axial force is uniform along the full length of the bar.'

breakdown.description: The prompt reduces the problem to one net-load stress state, which conflicts with the need to resolve different internal forces and displacements segment by segment.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix this inconsistency. Instead of setting up the problem for a segment-by-segment analysis as the ground truth does, the agent followed the user's flawed instruction to 'compute one stress level from the net applied load'. It calculated a single stress value ('The normal stress in each segment is 73.333 MPa') and applied it uniformly, which is incorrect.
